Design Notes — Identity Lock

  • Long SILVER-WHITE hair; great BLACK wings — NOT white wings.
  • White + RED priest robe over black; straw-rope sash.
  • Folding fan — not a staff; red tengu mask at the side of the head.
  • Snowfall. Keep the reference's soft dreamy glow, bloom and painterly finish — never flat studio.
  • Pure Edo fantasy; no modern tech.
